```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot top 100 frequently mutated cancer genes from MAF
# Based on user-provided cancerGeneList.tsv
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(maftools)
})
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Input files
# -------------------------------

cancer_gene_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2/Updated/cancerGeneList.tsv"

maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

# -------------------------------
# Output directory
# -------------------------------

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/plots/Oncovar_gene"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# -------------------------------
# Read cancer gene list
# -------------------------------

cancer_dt <- fread(cancer_gene_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)

# Detect Hugo symbol column safely
possible_hugo_cols <- c("Hugo Symbol", "Hugo_Symbol", "HugoSymbol", "Gene", "SYMBOL")

hugo_col <- possible_hugo_cols[possible_hugo_cols %in% colnames(cancer_dt)]

cancer_genes <- unique(toupper(trimws(cancer_dt[[hugo_col]])))
cancer_genes <- cancer_genes[!is.na(cancer_genes) & cancer_genes != ""]

message("Number of cancer genes: ", length(cancer_genes))
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Read MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_dt <- fread(maf_file, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE)

required_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf_dt))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in MAF: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

maf_dt[, Hugo_Symbol_clean := toupper(trimws(Hugo_Symbol))]

# -------------------------------
# Define non-silent / protein-altering variants
# -------------------------------

nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)
```


```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Filter MAF to cancer genes + nonsilent variants
# -------------------------------

cancer_maf <- maf_dt[
  Hugo_Symbol_clean %in% cancer_genes &
    Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes
]

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf_dt))
message("Cancer-gene nonsilent MAF rows: ", nrow(cancer_maf))

if (nrow(cancer_maf) == 0) {
  stop("No cancer-gene nonsilent mutations found. Please check gene symbols and variant classes.")
}
cat("Cancer-gene nonsilent MAF rows:", nrow(cancer_maf), "\n")

cat("Unique mutated cancer genes:", uniqueN(cancer_maf$Hugo_Symbol), "\n")

cat("Unique mutated samples:", uniqueN(cancer_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode), "\n")

cat(
  "Unique gene-sample mutation pairs:",
  uniqueN(paste(cancer_maf$Hugo_Symbol, cancer_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, sep = "__")),
  "\n"
)
```
```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Save filtered MAF
# -------------------------------

filtered_maf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_nonsilent_filtered.maf"
)

fwrite(
  cancer_maf[, !"Hugo_Symbol_clean"],
  filtered_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)# -------------------------------
# Save filtered MAF
# -------------------------------

filtered_maf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_nonsilent_filtered.maf"
)

fwrite(
  cancer_maf[, !"Hugo_Symbol_clean"],
  filtered_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# -------------------------------
# Frequency summary
# Frequency = number of unique mutated samples per gene
# -------------------------------

total_samples <- uniqueN(maf_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

gene_summary <- cancer_maf[
  ,
  .(
    Mutated_Samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    Variant_Count = .N,
    Variant_Classification = paste(sort(unique(Variant_Classification)), collapse = ";")
  ),
  by = .(Hugo_Symbol)
]

gene_summary[
  ,
  Frequency_Percent := round((Mutated_Samples / total_samples) * 100, 2)
]

setorder(
  gene_summary,
  -Mutated_Samples,
  -Variant_Count,
  Hugo_Symbol
)

# Save full summary
summary_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_mutation_frequency_all_genes.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  gene_summary,
  summary_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# Top 100
top100 <- head(gene_summary, 100)

top100_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_top100_mutated_genes.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  top100,
  top50_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Barplot: Top 100 frequently mutated cancer genes
# -------------------------------

top100[, Hugo_Symbol := factor(Hugo_Symbol, levels = rev(top100$Hugo_Symbol))]

p <- ggplot(
  top100,
  aes(
    x = Hugo_Symbol,
    y = Mutated_Samples
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(Mutated_Samples, " / ", total_samples, " (", Frequency_Percent, "%)")
    ),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 100 Frequently Mutated Cancer Genes",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Filtered using cancerGeneList.tsv; frequency based on unique mutated samples, n = ",
      total_samples,
      " samples"
    ),
    x = "Cancer gene",
    y = "Number of mutated samples"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

pdf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_top100_mutated_genes_barplot.pdf"
)

png_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  "Tier1_common_cancerGeneList_top100_mutated_genes_barplot.png"
)

ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 12
)

ggsave(
  filename = png_file,
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 300
)
```
